title: Siege of El Rahmaniya
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of El Rahmaniya", at revision 1370741021, opens: "The siege of El Rahmaniya was initiated by an Anglo-Ottoman force against the French troops in El Rahmaniya. After some engagements, the French troops surrendered the town to the allies." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q126325733, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1801 battle of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
